name: Covariance Matrix Estimation for Anisotropy
definition: An algorithm to estimate normal vectors and covariance matrices for each voxel to determine anisotropy, using ambient sphere sampling and projection onto the tangent plane.
summary: Covariance Matrix Estimation for Anisotropy estimates anisotropy by sampling a scalar field within an ambient sphere to construct a 2D covariance matrix, capturing feature extent in both spatial and data domains rather than just sharp isosurfaces.
